question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 D 组：美国 vs 澳大利亚（90 分钟赛果）？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group D: United States vs Australia (90-minute result)?
one_liner_cn: 美国坐拥西雅图主场以约41%小幅领先，但澳大利亚Elo更高、备战最充分，平局与客队爆冷空间不小。
one_liner_en: The USA edge ahead at about 41% on true home advantage in Seattle, but Australia carry the higher Elo and the most thorough preparation — meaningful room for a draw or an away win.

key_reasons.cn: 真主场优势：比赛在西雅图 Lumen Field 进行，美国作为东道主全部小组赛都在本土，模型按惯例给 +100 Elo 主场加成，这是美国概率领先的主因。
key_reasons.en: Genuine home advantage: the match is at Lumen Field, Seattle; as co-hosts the USA play all group matches on home soil, earning the standard +100 Elo host bonus — the main driver of their edge.

key_reasons.cn: 两队伤情大致抵消但美国略重：美国失去主力后腰 Cardoso、前锋 Agyemang，主力中卫 Richards 伤愈状态存疑；澳大利亚缺 McGree、Yazbek、Miller。
key_reasons.en: Injuries roughly offset but tilt slightly against the USA: Cardoso (first-choice DM) and Agyemang are out and starting CB Richards is a fitness doubt; Australia miss McGree, Yazbek and Miller.

key_reasons.cn: 评级信号相反：Elo 上澳大利亚 1777（第28）高于美国 1726（第39），但 FIFA 排名美国第16高于澳洲第27——基本面接近，比赛结果不确定性高。
key_reasons.en: Rating systems disagree: Elo has Australia (1777, No. 28) above the USA (1726, No. 39), while FIFA ranks the USA 16th vs Australia 27th — fundamentals are close and uncertainty is high.

method_note: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7) with +100 host bonus for USA home group match; p_stat 42.3/25.7/31.9 then bounded evidence adjustment of -1pp USA / +1pp Australia (injury balance, send-off loss). Market-blind: no odds or prediction-market inputs.
